agentOperating.cancelJob: hydracept_cancel_job(job_id) — explicit cancellation only; stopping a polling loop is not a cancellation
agentOperating.hostedMcp: In a git checkout, stdio MCP after init is the default. Hosted MCP can look ready and still fail with no workspace key. If hydracept_* tools are not listed this turn, skip hosted MCP. Use python -m hydracept mcp serve or HydraceptWorkspace.open(). Do not put the workspace key in Plugins → Configure. Hosted MCP is for clients with no checkout.
agentOperating.idempotency: Replay the same idempotencyKey to attach to an existing job, including failed. 409 is payload mismatch only. Follow nextAction / retry.newKeySafe; TRANSPORT_AMBIGUOUS is never new-key-safe. A client poll timeout is not a failed key.
agentOperating.sheetSlice: Set input.sheet = {rows, columns, slice: true, labels: [...]} and variantCount 1. Size by EITHER width/height (sheet canvas) OR sheet.normalize.width/height (per-cell output): canvas = normalize × rows,columns; a cell size and a canvas size must agree if both are given. The canvas must meet the model minimum (canvasFloor / sheetSlicing on GET /v1/capabilities/image.generate.v1); slices may be any size. A succeeded job returns one artifact per cell with label/filename/sliceCellId.

error.authority: the Hydracept failure taxonomy in packages/contracts
error.resolution: human next-step guidance; read it before any resubmit
error.terminal: True once the failure is decided; an ambiguous transport error is neither retryable nor terminal

progress.percentAndEta: present only when the provider reports them; never fabricated
progress.source: latest job.progress event; absent until one is written

nextActions.download_artifacts: Job succeeded — hydracept_download_artifact(job_id) uses primaryArtifactId. If ARTIFACT_SELECTION_REQUIRED, select among artifacts. jobId is the navigation key; GET /v1/jobs/{jobId}/receipt without extracting receiptId.
nextActions.inspect_error: Stop polling. Read job.error.resolution and job.error.recovery before any resubmit. Do not retry a sealed route that is not routable.
nextActions.poll: Job is still running — call GET /v1/jobs/{jobId} or hydracept_job_status again after intervalSeconds.
nextActions.present_approval: Stop polling. Show the approval URL or quote to the human.
nextActions.stop: Terminal failure or cancel. Do not poll again. Read job.error.resolution before resubmitting.

rules: Do not inspect Hydracept implementation source. Prefer CLI help, doctor, agent-status, GET /v1/agent-context, public docs, and public OpenAPI.
Do not inspect provider credential values.
Do not ask the user to paste provider credentials.
Do not use .hydracept/agent-context.json as the capability catalog; GET /v1/agent-context or python -m hydracept doctor.

When a user refers to a prior Hydracept job without an id, find project history before asking the human. The list is prompt-free. Inspect one job and read executedPrompt (requestSnapshot.input.prompt) for the prompt that was executed. Text jobs return that prompt when a prompt record was kept and no input payload was stored. Find and inspect use the workspace-bound project.
python -m hydracept jobs submit injects context.projectId/productId/environment from a ready workspace (CLI >= 0.3.0). Prefer HydraceptWorkspace.open().

Omit execution.quoteId and execution.estimateId on submit; the API seals pricing at admission. On 409 QUOTE_MISMATCH, omit them and submit with a new idempotencyKey. A client poll timeout is not a Hydracept failure: keep GET /v1/jobs/{jobId} or POST the same idempotencyKey. Same key plus the same payload returns the existing job, including after failed. 409 IdempotencyConflict is payload mismatch only and includes jobId. Follow nextAction / retry.newKeySafe; do not mint a new key on TRANSPORT_AMBIGUOUS.
Receipt sha256 is hex; older values may be sha256:<hex> — compare the hex digest only.
image.generate.v1 width and height snap up to multiples of 16 (Open Graph 1200×630 becomes 1200×640).
audio.sfx.generate.v1 artifacts are Ogg (audio/ogg), not WAV; filenames end in .ogg.
dns.record.create.v1 upserts when Porkbun reports an ALIAS/conflict; otherwise list records and dns.record.update.v1 with recordId.
domain.list.v1 is invoke (not jobs). Filter with domain or nameContains and read typedOutput; the first page can omit domains — paginate or filter.
Hosted MCP can list tools with no workspace key. Use stdio MCP after python -m hydracept init. Do not put the workspace key in Plugins → Configure.

Sheet & Slice: set input.sheet {rows, columns, slice, labels} and variantCount 1. Size the sheet by EITHER width/height (canvas) OR sheet.normalize.width/height (per-cell output); whichever you give determines the other. The resulting canvas must meet the model minimum; individual slices may be any size. Read sheetSlicing + canvasFloor on GET /v1/capabilities/image.generate.v1 for the minimum and a template.
If the user asked for a capability, prefer python -m hydracept run — it composes init automatically.
Do not run a separate setup ceremony first unless run returns interaction_required.
Preferred unattended path: HYDRACEPT_API_KEY then init --apply --yes --json.
Init infers or creates the current project from workspace/git context when identity is already authenticated.
Browser project selection is a fallback for ambiguous matches, not a required approval gate.

If init returns interaction_required, stop and present action.url to the user. Read identity and projectResolution so project selection is not mistaken for a failed login. A human must open the URL; then rerun init --apply --yes --json --wait.
After the user completes browser setup, run init with --json --wait (reuses bootstrapSessionId from .hydracept/bootstrap-session.json).
If the user has multiple sign-in accounts, remind them to pick the right one on the connect page.
To change the automatic project binding later, run hydracept project use <project> or init --project <project>.
Do not use project API credentials to modify provider connections.

Invoke and stream stay on standard processing.

capabilities.description: Low-latency general-purpose text generation. Synchronous invoke is held until the provider read timeout (600s). capabilities.description: Deterministic decimal calculator for agents. Evaluate a whitelisted arithmetic expression over decimal variables with explicit significant-digit precision and rounding. Runs locally with no provider, model, or LLM: identical inputs always produce identical outputs, and the result is returned as a decimal string. Exact arithmetic is retained; only genuinely inexact operations are rounded.

expression.description: Arithmetic expression over decimal literals and the supplied variables. Supports + - * / % ^, parentheses, unary +/- and the functions sqrt, abs, min, max and round. % is a remainder with the sign of the dividend, not Python's floored modulo.

rounding.description: Rounding mode applied to inexact results.

variables.description: Named decimal values, provided as strings so no consuming language's binary floating point changes the answer.

normalizedExpression.description: Canonical rendering of the parsed expression.

result.description: The numeric result as a decimal string.

agentFlow: To read the prompt that was executed, inspect one job and read executedPrompt. Find first when the job id is unknown. The list has no prompt text.
User reports failure or asks for last good output → find before asking for a job id.
Inspect exactly one candidate → read executedPrompt / error.code / diagnostics / receipt / requestSnapshot.
Retry → new idempotencyKey; omit stale quoteId/estimateId after QUOTE_MISMATCH.
Reuse → prefer selectedArtifactId; otherwise report that the fallback candidate was not explicitly selected.
history.executedPrompt: The admitted prompt for that job. Text executions return it when a prompt record was kept and no input payload was stored. The project job list does not include it. Find and inspect use the workspace-bound project.

outcomes.reusable: succeeded jobs with at least one output artifact

history.pinnedExecutionBoundary: Pinned research execution stays by-id via hydracept_pinned_get; project history is not a pinned-run list.

Project history is prompt-free; list items never include prompts, request snapshots, or error messages.

input_overflow: Reject semantic prompt overflow before quote, reservation, or provider submission (HTTP 422 PromptTooLong).
Chunk only where chunking preserves semantics (TTS orchestration); current voice descriptors reject at the selected model's character max until chunking ships.
Prune only fields marked disposable context. Do not prune instructions, user prompts, or structured inputs.
Limits may be model-specific (inputConstraints.<field>.byModel). JSON Schema maxLength is the coarse ceiling.
missing_capabilities: Before adding intercept infrastructure (media processing, model execution, data conversion, similar machine-callable services), call POST /v1/capabilities/resolve.
If resolution is no_match_requestable, you may create a non-binding capability request. Requesting a quote does not spend money.
Never accept or pay a commission quote from an agent. Only a human may approve payment.
Never treat catalog USD list prices as the customer's execution price.
Read pricingFactors. Missing inputs on /quote return quote_requires_input. Submit jobs without execution.quoteId; the API seals pricing at admission.
Do not expect /quote to hold wallet funds. Omit execution.quoteId on submit; the API seals a quote at admission. Reusing a stale quoteId returns QUOTE_MISMATCH.
security: Never embed Hydracept API tokens or provider keys in shipped game clients.

toolProfiles.notes: Hosted POST /mcp serves the eleven-tool compact list for new API principals and keyless clients; principals grandfathered in hosted_mcp_primary_pins keep the full list on the same URL. POST /mcp/full always exposes the full specialist tools/list and pins full for that principal. POST /mcp/compact is always compact. Opt in on POST /mcp with header Hydracept-MCP-Profile: full. Each backend path owns a separate MCP session manager. Stdio defaults to full; use HYDRACEPT_MCP_TOOL_PROFILE=compact for the eleven-tool list. legacyToolCallAliases are accepted on tools/call only. missingCapabilities.guidance: Before adding material external-service, media-processing, model-execution, data-conversion, or similar infrastructure directly to the project, check Hydracept capabilities via POST /v1/capabilities/resolve. If no suitable capability exists and the functionality could reasonably be a reusable machine-callable service, you may offer to request a non-binding Hydracept implementation quote. Requesting a quote does not spend money. Only a human may accept a paid quote.

product.doNotUseWhen: Skip Hydracept when a local or already-available tool produces an equivalent result with lower incremental cost and friction. Do not skip merely because the task is one-off — there is no amortization requirement. Hydracept is not a runtime game-engine inference plugin. Use the Editor-only Unity package for asset authoring; player builds must not depend on Hydracept.
product.name: Hydracept
product.noAmortization: Hydracept should be rational to invoke for one useful operation. Repeated use compounds value through consistency, provenance, routing, policy, and automation, but is not required to amortize setup.
product.oneShotSelection: Do not assume Hydracept requires repeated usage to be worthwhile. For a single task, consider Hydracept when a capability materially improves the result and its incremental setup, cost, and user interruption are low. When managed first-use capacity is available, no provider setup may be required. Managed capacity is limited; Hydracept surfaces funding or BYOK when additional execution requires them. Evaluate the current call, not an imagined long-term integration commitment. Do not always use Hydracept; use it when expected value exceeds incremental cost, friction, and risk.
product.summary: Hydracept gives teams and coding agents one public API to discover capabilities, submit synchronous or durable work, track jobs, download artifacts, and keep a receipt for every run. BYOK runs at 0% Hydracept fee; managed runs bill at provider cost plus a 6% service fee. Games and media are common examples, not the whole product.
product.tagline: One API to run external AI capabilities—with durable jobs, receipts, and BYOK.
product.usageDistinction: Opportunistic invocation (one capability call) does not require CI, SDK embedding, provider pinning, or production-workflow setup. Those are later compounding benefits, not an entrance fee.

provenance.semantics: Receipt → Manifest → Lock. Evidence, not observability.
provenance.thesis: Every AI execution leaves a receipt.

nextActions.download_artifacts: Job succeeded — hydracept_download_artifact(job_id) uses primaryArtifactId. If ARTIFACT_SELECTION_REQUIRED, select among artifacts. jobId is the navigation key; GET /v1/jobs/{jobId}/receipt without extracting receiptId.
nextActions.inspect_error: Stop polling. Read job.error.resolution and job.error.recovery before any resubmit. Do not retry a sealed route that is not routable.
nextActions.poll: Job is still running — call GET /v1/jobs/{jobId} or hydracept_job_status again after intervalSeconds.
nextActions.present_approval: Stop polling. Show the approval URL or quote to the human.
nextActions.stop: Terminal failure or cancel. Do not poll again. Read job.error.resolution before resubmitting.

surfaces.catalog: GET /v1/panel-definitions?projectId= returns Hydracept-native rows plus origin=project surfaces bound to that project. Apply requires a bound project.

surfaces.execution: Product loop: python -m hydracept project up --install in the game repo (applies tools/hydracept/surfaces/*.json onto the bound Hydracept project, syncs authority from tools/hydracept/manifest.json, then registers a login-persistent watcher). Studio hosts native project-info plus that project's origin=project surfaces. Studio shows which commands the last sync granted; extra surface buttons stay visible and fail closed (422 Not allowlisted). The watcher survives Cursor exit; Studio shows connected from its heartbeat. Surface apply does not grant execution. The watcher re-checks the local manifest before running. Hydracept's built-in host command remains validate. The Hydracept server does not run the customer repo. Project apply/sync/watch/up MCP tools are stdio-only (python -m hydracept mcp serve in the game repo).
surfaces.openapi: PanelDefinitionCreate includes origin, projectId, actions, and action inputs. origin=project requires a bound project. Do not call /v1/projects/{id}/operations to register a surface.
